title: Two Phase Design-Build/Design-Bid-Build (DB/DBB) Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) for Construction of the Ground Based Strategic Deterrent (GBSD) Utility Corridor (UC) at Francis E. Warren Air Force Base (FEW AFB), Wyoming (WY)
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION NORTHWESTERN.ENDIST OMAHA.W071 ENDIST OMAHA
detail_text: Update 0002 (28 March 2026): The solicitation date is tentatively schedule for the week of 13 April 2026. A draft of the Phase Two solicitation requirements, evaluation criteria and Seed Project will be included to provide interested offerors a representative sample of task orders to be solicited under this contract. Update 0001 (6 March 2026): This acquisition has been updated to include Design-Bid-Build (DBB) as shown within the title. Reference the attached pre-solicitation notice and associated documents. Previously related notices were 1) W9128F25SM032 - Sources Sought Announcement of Ground Based Strategic Deterrent Utility Corridor, Francis E. Warren Air Force Base, Wyoming and 2) Industry Day - Ground Based Strategic Deterrent Utility Corridor, Francis E. Warren Air Force Base, Wyoming for reference.
